text:
parker: Quick catch from the SDK release smoke run: docs still show `max_tokens` in several snippets and the function-calling examples use the legacy `function_call` payload. Also noticed embed examples referencing `rwd-2` dims (should be `rwd-3-compat`).

lina: thanks for surfacing. can you paste the top 3 file paths? i'll take the migration guide and deprecation banner.

parker: found these: `docs/snippets/js/completions.md`, `docs/guides/migrations/v1-to-v2.md` (code blocks), and `docs/integrations/vector-stores/postgres.md`.

teo: i'll update JS/TS snippets. plan: jscodeshift transform for `max_tokens` -> `max_output_tokens` and update the function-calling example to the new `tool_calls` array shape. will open PR and add a short test in snippets smoke harness.

nora: i'll handle Python and Rust snippets. i'll also add a note in the migration guide about host vs private behavior — hosted retains a short compatibility shim while Private and Dedicated are strict.

sam: for the deprecation banner copy i propose: "Support for `max_tokens` and legacy function_call shape removed on 2026-07-01. Update your snippets by 2026-06-01 to avoid breakage." we should run this past Product but i think it's reasonable.

lina: approved for draft. i'll include an FAQ entry on "what breaks for Dedicated" and a short rollback tip.

teo: quick example i'll include in the PR (JS jscodeshift snippet):

```bash
# run jscodeshift to replace param name
jscodeshift -t codemods/rename-max-tokens.js docs/snippets/js
```

// and a minimal codemod transform (documented in the PR) to change object keys and update function payload shape to:

```jsonc
{
  "tool_calls": [
    { "tool": "lookup_user", "args": { "id": 123 }, "meta": { "from": "app" } }
  ]
}
```

parker: also flagging vector-store docs: some providers show `vector_dim: 1536` for rwd-2. For rwd-3-compat the dim is 2048. that'll break existing embeddings indexes if not reindexed. we should add a big red note in the vector-store pages.

nora: i'll update `docs/integrations/vector-stores/postgres.md` with a migration subsection: detect dim mismatch, run `REINDEX` job, small repro script sample.

sam: timeline: can we aim to merge snippets PRs in 48h, publish banner 72h after merge, and do a docs-site rebuild? infra please queue an expedited build so the banner hits the site.

infra-bot: PRs opened: 6123 (js), 6124 (py), 6125 (rust), 6126 (migration-guide). CI: lint + snippet smoke tests queued.

docs-ci: docs build queued — https://deploys.redwood-inference.com/builds/8421; smoke tests running (approx 30m).

lina: when merging i'll add a short codemod link in the migration guide for maintainers, and a troubleshooting tip: "If your tests expect `function_call` shape, update test harness adapters to parse `tool_calls` (one element array)."

teo: merged JS PR 6123, added jscodeshift instructions and example before/after snippet.

nora: opened Python + Rust PRs 6124 & 6125; added reindex script and compatibility notes.

sam: i'll draft the public deprecation email and internal runbook, and tag support for the first 48 hours after the change.

parker: thanks team. post-merge checklist for docs lead: 1) trigger site rebuild, 2) confirm redirects/anchors not broken, 3) add banner and FAQ link, 4) post announcement in #all-hands and #customer-success.

(THREAD END)
